(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) Sri Krupa Sagar Patil, learned counsel accepts notice for respondent No.5.
For the order proposed, notice to respondent No.9 is dispensed with.

2. In this petition, the petitioners have sought for the following reliefs:
"a) Issue a writ of mandamus directing respondents to consider the representations NC: 2024:KHC-K:9361 Annexure-F dated 30.02.2020 and initiate acquisition proceedings and pay fair and just compensation as per the Amended Act i.e, Right to Fair Compensation Act-2013, in respect of portion of land Sy.No.80/1 measuring to the extent of 17347 sq.ft., of village Belur-J, Tq. Dist. Kalaburagi belonging to the petitioners, in the interest of justice and equity.
b) Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble court deems fit in circumstances of the case, in the ends of justice and equity."

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the respondents and perused the material on record.
4.

It is the grievance of the petitioners that their representation dated 30.02.2020 at Annexure-F submitted to the respondents has not been considered so far by them, nor any order has been passed on the same.

Under these circumstances, the petitioners are before this Court by way of the present Nooruddin And Ors vs The Principal Secretary And Ors on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90241042/

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondents submit that if reasonable time is given, the respondents would consider and pass necessary orders on the said application/representation.

6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions, the respondents are hereby directed to address the grievances of the petitioners and consider their representation dated 30.02.2020 at Annexure-F and pass appropriate orders/take appropriate decision in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
7. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of.
